Maya (PM): quick idea: use a small rubric to pick customers for BYOK + retention pilots so requests stop being ad-hoc
Ethan (Infra): agree. what fields?
Maya (PM): thinking: regulatory flag, token volume, contract tier, past incidents. simple 0-5 for each, sum -> pilot bucket thresholds
Tess (Security): add data residency gating. if they require local-only storage we route to legal before pilot
Liam (Sales): sales can provide a curated list of 8 prospects who might convert if we ship this. will share by Tue
Clara (Legal): legal wants an addendum template for retention changes and a record of the rubric decision per customer
Maya (PM): proposed pilot: pick top 6 for BYOK, 6 for extended retention; do internal dry-run then 6-week customer pilots
Ethan (Infra): rough engineering asks: per-tenant retention toggles, audit export API, BYOK handshake flow. estimate 3-5 sprints total for MVP
Tess (Security): BYOK acceptance: KMS attestation, rotation policy, threat model doc. will review once spike outputs are in
cal-bot: meeting created: Compliance Pilot kickoff 2024-10-08 14:00 UTC
Maya (PM): next steps: Liam shares list (Tue), Clara drafts addendum (EOW), Ethan runs spike (2w). I'll draft the rubric spreadsheet and PRD after those inputs.
